items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses writing a score for 'Mickey One' and mentions 'Stan got that', but does not identify Mickey One as a person he interacted with personally; 'Mickey One' appears to be the title of a work or project.

ctx.x: On this one I didn't do that, (inaudible); how could he know where to be, so I wrote it out, and play it as you please.
The score for Mickey One is much busier.
